Embracing Agentic AI Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control. Unified detection and response across data sources AI-driven anomaly detection with context Pre-built content and playbooks The Result: Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent. SEE HOW Alerts to Action. Evolving to the Agentic SOC Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex, teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time. Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight. With Securonix: Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance Strengthen breach readiness across the environment Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2 SEE HOW Meet Sam The AI SOC Analyst Sam, t he AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior, understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response. Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.
